decision.observation: 10:00 pm; the farmer stands just north-west of JojaMart beside a 'Joja Cola' billboard. A rocky cliff rises to the west — appears to be the east edge of the accessible area rather than a road.
decision.hypothesis: The road heading into town runs south of JojaMart, so going south then west around the building should find the way toward the fountain and the farm road.
decision.memory: West of JojaMart is a dead-end against the cliff; the town road is south of the building.
